name: test-plan
description: Comprehensive test planning documentation with test cases, coverage analysis, and execution strategy
purpose: Create detailed test plans that ensure thorough coverage and systematic testing approach

format.structure: Overview > Scope > Strategy > Test Cases > Execution Plan > Criteria

template:
# Test Plan: [Feature/Release Name]

## Test Overview

### Purpose
**Feature:** [Feature or system being tested]
**Version:** [Version number or release]
**Test Objective:** [Primary testing goals]
**Scope:** [What will and won't be tested]

### Test Summary
- **Total Test Cases:** [Number]
- **Estimated Effort:** [Person-hours]
- **Timeline:** [Start date] - [End date]
- **Risk Level:** [High/Medium/Low]

## Scope Definition

### In Scope
- [Feature/functionality 1]
- [Feature/functionality 2]
- [Integration points]
- [Performance requirements]

### Out of Scope
- [Excluded features/functionality]
- [Known limitations]
- [Dependencies handled elsewhere]

### Test Levels
- **Unit Testing:** [Coverage and responsibility]
- **Integration Testing:** [Components and interfaces]
- **System Testing:** [End-to-end scenarios]
- **Acceptance Testing:** [Business validation]

## Test Strategy

### Testing Approach
- **Manual Testing:** [Scenarios requiring manual verification]
- **Automated Testing:** [Test cases for automation]
- **Exploratory Testing:** [Areas for ad-hoc investigation]

### Test Types
- **Functional Testing:** [Business logic validation]
- **Non-Functional Testing:** [Performance, security, usability]
- **Regression Testing:** [Existing functionality verification]
- **Compatibility Testing:** [Cross-platform/browser support]

### Test Environment
- **Hardware:** [Required hardware specifications]
- **Software:** [OS, browsers, dependencies]
- **Data:** [Test data requirements]
- **Network:** [Network configuration needs]

## Test Cases

### Test Case Template
```
Test Case ID: TC-[XXX]
Title: [Descriptive test case name]
Priority: [High/Medium/Low]
Test Type: [Functional/Performance/Security/etc.]

Preconditions:
- [Setup requirement 1]
- [Setup requirement 2]

Test Steps:
1. [Action step 1]
2. [Action step 2]
3. [Verification step]

Expected Result:
[What should happen]

Actual Result:
[To be filled during execution]

Status:
[Pass/Fail/Blocked/Not Executed]
```

### High Priority Test Cases

#### TC-001: [Core Functionality Test]
**Priority:** High
**Description:** [Test the primary feature functionality]
**Steps:**
1. [Step 1]
2. [Step 2]
3. [Verification]
**Expected:** [Expected outcome]

#### TC-002: [Error Handling Test]
**Priority:** High
**Description:** [Test error conditions and recovery]
**Steps:**
1. [Step 1]
2. [Step 2]
3. [Verification]
**Expected:** [Expected error handling]

### Medium Priority Test Cases
[Additional test cases following same format]

### Low Priority Test Cases
[Additional test cases following same format]

## Test Execution Plan

### Phase 1: Core Functionality (Days 1-3)
- Execute high priority test cases
- Focus on critical business flows
- **Entry Criteria:** [Requirements]
- **Exit Criteria:** [Success conditions]

### Phase 2: Integration Testing (Days 4-6)
- Test component interactions
- Verify data flow between systems
- **Entry Criteria:** [Requirements]
- **Exit Criteria:** [Success conditions]

### Phase 3: End-to-End Testing (Days 7-9)
- Complete user workflows
- Cross-browser/platform testing
- **Entry Criteria:** [Requirements]
- **Exit Criteria:** [Success conditions]

### Phase 4: Regression Testing (Days 10-12)
- Verify existing functionality
- Performance validation
- **Entry Criteria:** [Requirements]
- **Exit Criteria:** [Success conditions]

## Entry and Exit Criteria

### Entry Criteria
- [ ] Test environment setup complete
- [ ] Test data prepared
- [ ] Application deployed to test environment
- [ ] Unit testing completed with >90% pass rate
- [ ] Known critical bugs resolved

### Exit Criteria
- [ ] 95% of high priority test cases passed
- [ ] 90% of medium priority test cases passed
- [ ] All critical and high severity bugs resolved
- [ ] Performance benchmarks met
- [ ] Security scan completed with no critical issues

### Suspension Criteria
- More than 20% of test cases failing
- Critical environment issues
- Test-blocking bugs discovered

## Risk Assessment

### Technical Risks
- **[Risk 1]:** [Impact and mitigation strategy]
- **[Risk 2]:** [Impact and mitigation strategy]

### Schedule Risks
- **[Risk 1]:** [Impact and mitigation strategy]
- **[Risk 2]:** [Impact and mitigation strategy]

### Quality Risks
- **[Risk 1]:** [Impact and mitigation strategy]
- **[Risk 2]:** [Impact and mitigation strategy]

## Resource Requirements

### Team Members
- **Test Lead:** [Name and responsibilities]
- **QA Engineers:** [Names and assignments]
- **Automation Engineers:** [Names and responsibilities]
- **Business Analysts:** [Names and validation role]

### Tools and Infrastructure
- **Test Management:** [Tool name and access]
- **Automation Framework:** [Framework and setup]
- **Performance Testing:** [Tools and environment]
